name: Sachiko and Maya: Friends in the Countryside
source:
When yokai appear in the village, Maya and Sachiko must act quickly. Will you confront them, drive them away, or find clever ways to keep the village safe? Adventure and friendship await in every choice.

[From [url=https://leafletgames.itch.io/sachiko-and-maya-friends-in-the-countryside]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当妖怪出现在村庄时，玛雅和幸子必须迅速采取行动。你会对抗他们，赶走他们，还是找到聪明的方法来保证村庄的安全？每一个选择都等待着冒险和友谊。

[来自[url=https://leafletgames.itch.io/sachiko-and-maya-friends-in-the-countryside]Itch.io[/url]]
